lines.t: (Verse 1)
Golden skies, the morning slow,
footsteps fade where soft winds blow.
Worries fade like distant rain,
peace returns and breaks the chain.
Quiet air, the world at rest,
sunlight dances on my chest.
All my striving starts to cease,
wrapped in mercy, endless peace.
(Pre-Chorus)
My heartbeat matches quiet air,
I find Your presence everywhere.
Time stands still, I start to see,
what rest was meant to be.
(Chorus)
Take me where the still waters flow,
breathe in light, let the Spirit show.
Every thought begins to slow,
I’m not alone, I’m finally home.
(Verse 2)
Gentle light beneath the trees,
freedom found in days like these.
Sacred rhythm soft and kind,
peace and grace renew my mind.
Whispers float on evening air,
every sound becomes a prayer.
I close my eyes, I hear You say,
“Rest with Me, the world can wait.”
(Bridge)
Here in stillness, I’m made whole,
quiet rivers cleanse my soul.
Every heartbeat, every sigh,
a hallelujah passing by.
No need to chase the fading sun,
the week is gone, the rest’s begun.
My soul unwinds, the shadows flee,
Your love surrounds and carries me.
Take me where the still waters flow,
breathe in light, let the Spirit show.
Every thought begins to slow,
I’m not alone, I’m finally home.
Let the calm wash over me,
like the tide that sets me free.
You’re the peace my heart has known,
I’m not alone, I’m finally home.
I’m not alone, I’m finally home.
I’m not alone, I’m finally home.
